value.rationale: The comb constraints make longitudinal occupation of the backbone compete with transverse dispersion. A random common reset age can exactly cancel and then reverse this intrinsic anticorrelation; the theorem supplies the sharp universal ratio from +1/5 to -1/5, the exact shape threshold k=1, and a full-distribution independence criterion. These are natural experimentally interpretable fourth-order dependence signatures across a complete physical parameter family, not marginal variance recomputation.
